articles.title: Mother Vanishes with Lover, Leaves Five Children Alone in Mainpuri
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, a woman from Kashiram Colony in the Kotwali area of Mainpuri city allegedly fled with her lover, leaving her five children alone at home. The woman, Sangeeta, was married to Ankul of Kashiram Colony about 10 years ago. The couple has five children.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, a woman from Kashiram Colony in the Kotwali area of Mainpuri city allegedly fled with her lover, leaving her five children alone at home.

The woman, Sangeeta, was married to Ankul of Kashiram Colony about 10 years ago. The couple has five children. Ankul works as a truck driver and often stayed away from home for days. During this period, Sangeeta reportedly came in contact with a youth from Kanpur, and the acquaintance later turned into a relationship.

According to the family, Sangeeta left the house with her lover, allegedly taking gold and silver jewellery. It is also alleged that she withdrew around ₹70,000 from a loan taken in Ankul’s name.

The children are in shock after their mother’s sudden disappearance. The youngest, a two-year-old girl, has been crying constantly, while the others are waiting for her return.

Ankul has appealed to the administration for justice and sought action to ensure the safety and future of his children. He has demanded a probe into the matter.

articles.title: Synthetic Milk Shock in Mumbai: Viral Video Exposes Alleged Racket in Andheri
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai has witnessed fresh allegations of milk adulteration, with residents of Andheri West’s Kapaswadi area claiming that synthetic milk is being supplied openly in the locality, posing a serious public health risk.

body.html:
Mumbai has witnessed fresh allegations of milk adulteration, with residents of Andheri West’s Kapaswadi area claiming that synthetic milk is being supplied openly in the locality, posing a serious public health risk.

A viral video, reportedly shot by locals along with a policeman, shows a room filled with milk packets and a man allegedly demonstrating the method used to adulterate milk. Netizens claim the racket has been operating for decades.

Residents allege that chemicals such as detergent, urea, soap solution and refined oil are mixed with water to dilute original milk and nearly double the quantity. They also claim genuine dairy packets are diverted to private locations, adulterated, repacked and then supplied to households.
Medical experts warn that prolonged consumption of adulterated milk can cause kidney and liver damage, growth issues in children and other health complications.

The allegations have raised questions over monitoring by the BMC, food safety authorities and the Mumbai Police. Locals have demanded immediate inspections and strict action.

So far, there has been no official response from civic or food safety agencies. Further verification is awaited.

articles.title: Rs 13-Crore Ropeway Collapses in Trial Run, Safety Fears Rock Rohtas
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bihar: A ropeway under construction in Rohtas district collapsed during a trial run on Friday, raising serious concerns over safety and construction quality. The Rs 13-crore project’s pillar failed to bear the load, causing it and the trolley to fall, while the cable also snapped.

body.html:
Bihar: A ropeway under construction in Rohtas district collapsed during a trial run on Friday, raising serious concerns over safety and construction quality. The Rs 13-crore project’s pillar failed to bear the load, causing it and the trolley to fall, while the cable also snapped.

Officials said no one was inside the trolley at the time, preventing any casualties. The ropeway was being built to connect the Rohtas block headquarters with the historic Chaurasan (Rohiteshwar Mahadev) Temple and was scheduled to open in the new year.

Following the incident, work on the project has been suspended. Local residents questioned the quality of construction and demanded strict action against those responsible.

LJP MLA Murari Prasad Gautam condemned the collapse, alleging negligence by the department and engineers, and called for a thorough investigation and action against the guilty.

The Chaurasan Temple, an ancient Shiva shrine accessed by 84 steps, is a major religious and tourist site in Rohtas, attracting thousands of devotees every year.

body.html:
Rajasthan: A female manager of a private IT company was allegedly gang-gg-ped in a moving car in Udaipur after attending her CEO’s birthday and year-end party on December 20. The accused — company CEO Jitesh Prakash Sisodia, senior executive Shilpa, and her husband Gaurav Sirohi — have been arrested.

According to police, the party was held at a private hotel and continued till around 1.30 am. The trio offered to drop the woman home. On the way, they allegedly made her smoke, after which she lost consciousness. In her complaint, the victim said she regained partial consciousness to find herself being sexually assaulted, and was dropped home around 5 am. Later, she found her underwear, socks and earrings missing, with injury marks on her pr**** parts.

Udaipur SP Yogesh Goyal said the medical report confirms injuries and there is prima facie evidence of gang gg-pe. Police are examining audio and video from a dashcam installed in the car, which reportedly captured the incident.

articles.title: AI Took My Job, So I Became a Thief”: Bunty-Babli Style Jewellery Heist Shocks Indore
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational theft has been reported from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, where a young man and woman allegedly looted gold and silver jewellery worth over ₹15 lakh from a jeweller’s shop in the Rau police station area. The theft took place on the night of December 22.

body.html:
A sensational theft has been reported from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, where a young man and woman allegedly looted gold and silver jewellery worth over ₹15 lakh from a jeweller’s shop in the Rau police station area.

The theft took place on the night of December 22. Acting on a suspicious vehicle number, police traced the suspects to Mandla and later arrested them from Bhopal. A large quantity of stolen jewellery was recovered.

Police said the duo had first visited the shop during the day, bought a ring and conducted a recce. Later that night, they broke in and stole around 10 to 12 tolas of gold and silver ornaments.

During interrogation, the man claimed he lost his job due to increased use of Artificial Intelligence and was under financial stress. The woman, from Mandla, was preparing for NEET in Indore and also facing money problems. This allegedly pushed them to plan the crime, inspired by the film Bunty Aur Babli.

DCP Krishnalal Chandni said the accused planned to sell the jewellery after the Christmas holidays but were nabbed before they could do so. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: PM Modi Leaves, Shame Arrives: Lucknow’s Green Corridor Looted Within Hours
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: Shortly after Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded his visit to the city, videos surfaced showing people stealing decorative flower pots installed around the Rashtriya Prerna Sthal, bringing embarrassment to the state capital.

body.html:
Lucknow: Shortly after Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded his visit to the city, videos surfaced showing people stealing decorative flower pots installed around the Rashtriya Prerna Sthal, bringing embarrassment to the state capital.

PM Modi was in Lucknow on Thursday to inaugurate the Rashtriya Prerna Sthal and pay tribute to former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. For the occasion, the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) and the Municipal Corporation had beautified the area with flower pots and hanging decorations along Rashtriya Prerna Sthal Marg, the Green Corridor and Vasant Kunj Road.

However, soon after the Prime Minister left, several people were seen removing the pots and taking them away on two-wheelers, four-wheelers and even by hand. The decorations, installed at public expense, were damaged within hours.

Bystanders recorded the scenes, and the videos went viral on social media, drawing sharp criticism. Netizens questioned whether action would be taken against those involved.

articles.title: Love Trap Turns into Loot: Bengaluru Honey-Trap Gang Busted After Shocking Extortion #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru police have arrested five members of a honey-trap gang that allegedly extorted money from youths by luring them through online platforms.

body.html:
Bengaluru police have arrested five members of a honey-trap gang that allegedly extorted money from youths by luring them through online platforms. The RR Nagar police identified the accused as Sumalatha alias Anjali (28), Harshini alias Sweety (26), Jagadish (35), Manjunath (30) and Lokesh (32).

The arrests were made based on a complaint by a software engineer. Police said the gang contacted victims through Telegram, persuaded them to book girls online, and then extorted cash.

On December 1, the complainant went to an address shared by a woman he contacted through Telegram. She allegedly snatched ₹20,000 in cash and his mobile phone, and threatened to demand ₹1 lakh. The victim managed to retrieve his phone and escape.

On December 20, he again booked another girl through Telegram and reached a location in RR Nagar. There, the same woman, another girl and three men allegedly attacked him, robbed ₹20,000, demanded ₹1 lakh and attempted to kidnap him in a car.

Hearing his screams, locals alerted 112. Police rushed to the spot, rescued the victim and arrested the accused. A case has been registered at RR Nagar police station, and further investigation is under way.
